# Load Libraries and Data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(mice)
library(howManyImputations)
library(gtsummary)
library(survey)
library(mitools)
df <- haven::read_dta("gcq_hsls_subset.dta")
```

# Imputations
```{r}
library(mice)
# get rid of haven labelled for imputation
df <- df %>% as_factor()
# check missing data
df_nw <- df %>% dplyr::select(-starts_with("w1"))
colSums(is.na(df_nw))

# Binary should be be 0/1 factor for logreg
df_nw <- df_nw %>% mutate(
  first_gen = factor(first_gen, levels = c(0,1)),
  exp_ba = factor(exp_ba, levels = c(0,1))
)

# Ordinal must be ordered factors
df$math_3level <- ordered(df$math_3level)
df$par_exp     <- ordered(df$par_exp)
df$pov_level <- ordered(df$pov_level)

# 1. Dry run: iterations = 0
init <- mice(df_nw, maxit = 0)
meth <- init$method
meth
```


```{r}

# Binary should be be 0/1 factor for logreg
df <- df %>% mutate(
  first_gen = factor(first_gen, levels = c(0,1)),
  exp_ba = factor(exp_ba, levels = c(0,1))
) 

# Ordinal must be ordered factors
df$math_3level <- ordered(df$math_3level)
df$par_exp     <- ordered(df$par_exp)
df$pov_level <- ordered(df$pov_level)

df_subset <- df %>% dplyr::select(x1race, par_exp, math_3level, par_race, par_sch_inv, first_gen, first_lang, frpl, math_score, public, urban, x1race, starts_with("w1"), pov_level, p1eduaspire, x3thimath9, x1sex, x1ses, x1sesq5, x1txmtscor, x1duallang, x1par1race)

# Run chained equations imputation
df_imp <- mice(
  df_subset,
  m        = 40,     
  seed     = 123456
)

# Save the imputed data
save(df_imp, "df_imputed.rdata")
```

## Racial/Ethnic Subgroups

### Write function
```{r}
load("df_imputed.rdata")
run_hsls_glm <- function(data) {
  glm(
    p1honors ~ math_3level + 
      par_exp + par_race + par_sch_inv +
      first_gen + first_lang + frpl +
      math_score + public + urban,
    data = data,
    family = "binomial"
  )
}

```
